HextaAI is a complete AI chat app made from every HextaUI AI block. Chat Sidebar holds the history, Chat Thread holds the conversation, Prompt Input is the composer, and each reply is drawn from its parts: Thinking for reasoning, Tool Calls for what the agent did, Agent Todos for its plan, Code Block for diffs and terminals, and Streaming Markdown for the answer. Artifact opens web pages, documents and files the model makes in a panel beside the chat, with versions, and small changes are typed into the open file instead of rewriting it. Voice Mode opens from the composer and drops the conversation into the chat when you hang up.

The core is HextaMessageParts. It takes the same message parts the AI SDK’s useChat returns, groups neighbouring reasoning and tool calls, keeps one live plan at the top of the reply, and renders text with citations linked to the sources the model found. Reads, edits, writes, searches, web fetches and shell commands each get a fitting view, and you can add renderers for your own tools.

The demo runs on ScriptedChats, a small engine that streams realistic parts offline. Try a suggestion: make a pricing page and watch it open beside the chat, research a question and watch sources come in, ask for a feature and review the plan before it runs, approve a test run that fails and gets fixed, or ask for an explanation with code and tables.
